author: Olympiodorus of Alexandria
occasion: The surviving lemma states that Olympiodorus, in the second book of his work against Severus, brought forward a passage of Saint Athanasius that speaks of two wills in Christ, and then expounded it.
argument: The transmitted text is only an introductory lemma. It reports that Olympiodorus cited Athanasius's statement about two wills in Christ and then proceeded to discuss it. The actual citation and Olympiodorus's exposition are not preserved in the source text provided. No further argumentation survives.

outline.move: All four sections contain the same introductory lemma identifying Olympiodorus and stating that he cited Athanasius on the two wills of Christ.
